verdict.rationale: The buzz-acp harness is documented to listen for @mentions on the relay, prompt the agent (goose, codex, claude code over ACP), and reply through the Buzz CLI. Agents get their own keypair identity, are enrolled with `add-member`, and the README states they have their own channel memberships. Remote-agent docs confirm agents are steered by mentioning them, and managed agents can be drafted directly into a channel via `buzz agents draft-create --channel`. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that mention-triggered channel participation works in practice; per-channel membership steps are only implied (add-member enrolls at the relay level).
